preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 30.
For each test case, the integer N must be between 2 and 1000.
The sum of N over all test cases must not exceed 1000.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly N integers for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(int(x) in range(1, N + 1) for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: All integers in the output must be within the range from 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: all(median(P[i]) != median(P[i + 1]) for i in range(N - 1))
postconditions.description: The medians of consecutive prefixes must be different.
